title: Installing TypeScript
overview: TypeScript can be installed using npm. The TypeScript compiler allows developers to convert TypeScript code into JavaScript code.

example.title: Install TypeScript
example.content:
npm install -g typescript

Check version:

tsc --version

title: Creating a TypeScript File
overview: TypeScript files use the .ts extension. Developers write TypeScript code inside these files and compile them into JavaScript.

example.title: TypeScript File
example.content:
Create file:

app.ts

Code:

let message: string = 'Hello TypeScript';

title: TypeScript Compiler
overview: The TypeScript compiler (tsc) converts TypeScript code into JavaScript that can run in browsers, Node.js, and React Native environments.

title: tsconfig.json File
overview: The tsconfig.json file contains TypeScript compiler configuration settings. It controls how TypeScript code is compiled.

title: TypeScript Setup in React Native
overview: React Native projects can be created with TypeScript support. TypeScript files use .tsx extension when they contain React components and JSX.

example.title: React Native TypeScript Files
example.content:
Component.tsx
Screen.tsx
Navigation.tsx

.tsx is used for React components.
